name: create_material
purpose: Mint a new UMaterial asset (master material) — the missing half of the Tier-0 material-authoring gap.
cooked: works — creates a NEW loose asset, never touches cooked content

name: create_material_function
purpose: Mint a UMaterialFunction asset so reusable graph fragments can be authored and called from materials.
cooked: works — new loose asset

name: add_material_expression
purpose: Add a node to a material or material-function graph — the atom of the Tier-0 material-graph-authoring gap.
cooked: refuses — cooked materials have no expression graph (Optional-class stripping)
hazards: Unknown property name in properties{} must error, never silent-ignore

name: connect_material_expressions
purpose: Wire expression output to expression input inside a material/function graph.
cooked: refuses — no expressions exist on cooked assets

name: connect_material_property
purpose: Wire an expression output into a material OUTPUT pin (BaseColor, Roughness…) — without this the graph never affects pixels.
cooked: refuses — cooked graph stripped
hazards: Expression outered to a MaterialFunction makes ConnectMaterialProperty return false

name: delete_material_expression
purpose: Remove one node (or all nodes) from a material/function graph — enables iterate-fix loops.
cooked: refuses — cooked graph stripped

name: list_material_expressions
purpose: Read-back for the whole authoring loop: enumerate graph nodes, positions, key parameters, connections, property bindings.
cooked: degraded — returns numExpressions:0 with explicit cooked:true flag
hazards: GetMaterialPropertyInputNode null-derefs for non-connectable MP_* values — query connectable list only

name: layout_material_expressions
purpose: Auto-arrange nodes in a grid after programmatic authoring so a human opening the asset sees a readable graph.
cooked: refuses — no expressions
hazards: Only lays out nodes reachable from property/function inputs — disconnected nodes not moved

name: recompile_material
purpose: Apply graph/parameter edits, dispatching on asset class (Material/Function/MIC) — without it none of the edits reach the renderer.
engineApi: UMaterialEditingLibrary::RecompileMaterial / UpdateMaterialFunction / UpdateMaterialInstance (MaterialEditingLibrary.h:164-165, :254-255, :327-328); reimplement UMaterial branch via FMaterialUpdateContext (MaterialShared.h:2779+)
cooked: refuses — no editor-only source to compile from
hazards: RecompileMaterial runs CollectGarbage TWICE mid-handler (MaterialEditorUtilities.cpp:789,:814)
FScopedSlowTask MakeDialog pumps UI mid-HTTP-handler (MaterialEditorUtilities.cpp:791-792)
CompileDebugViewModeShaders busy-waits on shader compiles (DebugViewModeHelpers.cpp:322-356)
Do NOT call RecompileMaterial for UMaterial — replicate its non-blocking core instead

name: get_material_stats
purpose: Numeric ground truth for a compiled material — 8 integers (instructions, samplers, fetches, interpolators) to prove an edit worked.
cooked: degraded — zeros when permutation missing; response carries cooked:true
hazards: GetStatistics calls Resource->FinishCompilation — synchronous game-thread shader wait
Pre-check IsGameThreadShaderMapComplete; return pending:true if incomplete

name: set_material_instance_parent
purpose: Re-parent an existing MaterialInstanceConstant (and optionally wipe its overrides) — parent is otherwise only settable at birth.
cooked: works on loose MIC; refuses when the MIC package is cooked (cannot save)

name: create_material_parameter_collection
purpose: Mint a UMaterialParameterCollection asset — global scalar/vector parameters, the one-knob-drives-50-materials mechanism.
cooked: works — new loose asset

name: set_mpc_parameters
purpose: Add/update/remove named parameters on an existing MPC with PreEditChange/PostEditChange propagation to referencing materials.
cooked: works on loose MPCs; refuses on cooked MPC assets (cannot save)
hazards: Engine clamps to 1024 scalars / 1024 vectors (ParameterCollection.cpp:245-257)

name: create_rvt_asset
purpose: Mint a URuntimeVirtualTexture asset with sizing/material-type set — the missing producer for the existing bind_landscape_rvt consumer.
cooked: works — new loose asset
hazards: TileCount/TileSize/TileBorderSize/MaterialType are protected — write via FProperty reflection, not direct C++

name: refresh_texture
purpose: Rebuild textures via UpdateResource after settings edits, with an honest Source.IsValid report per texture.
cooked: degraded — cooked textures have no FTextureSource; cannot regenerate compression/mips

name: shader_compile_status
purpose: THE poll endpoint for every material mutation on this axis and for editor-wide shader churn after level loads.
cooked: works — global editor state, independent of asset provenance

name: build_lighting
purpose: Kick a Lightmass static-lighting build for the loaded level from the bridge.
cooked: degraded — build may run but results cannot be persisted on cooked maps (cookedMap:true warning)
hazards: GWarn->ShowBuildProgressWindow always opens the build-progress window (EditorBuildUtils.cpp:364)
Synchronous MAP REBUILD ALLVISIBLE in-handler if level has non-volume BSP brushes (cpp:411-429)
BuildLighting is on FBuildOptions, not FEditorBuildUtils — wrong qualifier would not compile

name: lighting_build_status
purpose: Poll half for build_lighting (the async rule).
cooked: works — global editor state

name: build_reflection_captures
purpose: Re-capture all reflection captures in the world (Build → Reflection Captures) so specular ambience matches after edits.
cooked: degraded — MapBuildData results not persistable on cooked maps (cookedMap flag)
hazards: FinishAllCompilation: synchronous editor-wide asset-compile wait — pre-check shader_compile_status
GWarn->BeginSlowTask mid-handler (EditorEngine.cpp:3974)
Hard check() assert (crash) if feature level below SM5 — verify feature level first

name: create_render_target
purpose: Mint a transient UTextureRenderTarget2D (optionally baked to a static UTexture2D asset) — canvas for capture/verification loops.
cooked: n/a — transient objects; bake path creates loose assets
hazards: Transient RT held only in a native TMap is GC-invisible — root via TStrongObjectPtr with release path

name: read_render_target
purpose: Numeric pixel verification — read single pixels or areas from any render target, optionally export to disk for diffing.
cooked: works — render targets are runtime objects

name: validate_level_materials
purpose: Read-only structured report over all mesh components: null slots, default-material fallbacks, incomplete materials, LOD/Nanite mismatches.
cooked: works — precisely the endpoint for cooked content (missing-permutation diagnosis)
prevents: WorldGridMaterial default-material fallback symptom; cooked materials shipped without needed permutations

name: set_actor_render_overrides
purpose: Batch per-actor cull/LOD control — force LODs, set draw distances, exclude from HLOD — with render-state refresh.
cooked: works on placed actors in savable maps; refuses when the level is cooked
hazards: MinLOD silently ignored unless bOverrideMinLOD=true (StaticMeshComponent.h:226) is written too

name: get_actor_render_info
purpose: Read-back pair for set_actor_render_overrides: per-component LOD forcing, draw distances, HLOD flag, LOD count, Nanite, material slots.
engineApi: Same citation set as set_actor_render_overrides + UStaticMesh::GetNumLODs/IsNaniteEnabled (StaticMesh.h:1767/:870)
cooked: works — reading is always safe on cooked content
hazards: Report must include bOverrideMinLOD so agents can see whether MinLOD is live

name: set_material_instance_layers
purpose: Author a material-layers stack (layer + blend functions) on a MaterialInstanceConstant programmatically — viable in 5.3 on instances.
cooked: refuses — editor-only layer data stripped on cooked instances/functions
hazards: MaterialInstance.h:505 is a different SetMaterialLayers — call the :785 UMaterialInstance method
